requirements.text: Jobs defaults to media titles, current action, meaningful progress and actionable errors; technical identifiers and maintenance remain available on demand.

Stream bounded redacted live downloader activity, structured transfer bytes/speed/ETA when supplied, and early provider titles; unknown progress is indeterminate and transfer completion is distinct from finished output.
All archivers expose the same activity component and reduce repeated explanations, card framing and secondary setup above primary work; preserve existing actions and subscriptions.
Expose existing recurring workflows directly and consistently; do not imply an unimplemented image subscription capability exists.
Use bounded canonical paging, no overlapping polling, stale-response protection and visibility-aware work; technical views do not poll while closed.
Provide semantic frontend interaction and documented backend inspection for new behavior, retaining token authorization and quiet operation.
Verify final packaged screens and behavior through the built-in bridge without Computer Use; retain product version and changelog, all operator data and existing downloads.

validation: focused engine and frontend boundary tests
isolated packaged semantic and visual verification on all affected screens
